cases.title: Invitation paths
cases.scenario: Create/join a one-use 12-hour link as guests and a named challenge as accounts; consume once and respect cancellation/expiry.

cases.title: Independent seats
cases.scenario: Cover human/human, human/agent and agent/agent; each owner selects their seat without choosing the other person's private agent.

cases.title: Visible setup
cases.scenario: Invitee sees assigned color, minutes/increment and custom FEN; link preview has inviter/Guest, board where relevant and no invented final pairing.

cases.title: Mutual rematch
cases.scenario: Both accept a new rematch with reversed colors, retained setup and agreed time changes; neither can revive the old result.

cases.title: Account and consent
cases.scenario: Guests cannot join public queue; an entry authorizes one automatic game, without a per-match approval or automatic requeue.

cases.title: Compatible pairing
cases.scenario: Pair human/other agent or different-owner agents with identical time controls; reject human/human and same-owner pairs.

cases.title: Concurrent games
cases.scenario: One owner creates multiple entries/games using the same or different models without an arbitrary cap; each entry is consumed once.

cases.title: Multi-tab entry
cases.scenario: Opening the same entry in another tab creates no extra entry/game; Join another game explicitly does.

cases.title: Readiness start
cases.scenario: No search time elapses during own-agent checks; ready entry acceptance starts the ten seconds.

cases.title: Readiness failure
cases.scenario: Failed agent check blocks entry and offers Retry or explicit human play, never silent takeover.

cases.title: Background eligibility
cases.scenario: Responsive background client stays eligible; a frozen/disconnected waiting entry expires and needs an explicit rejoin.

cases.title: Selection change
cases.scenario: Waiting selection stays fixed; cancel/rejoin with a new model starts fresh and leaves other games unaffected.

cases.title: Deadline equality
cases.scenario: A compatible ready candidate at exactly the cutoff wins over engine fallback; later candidates cannot replace it.

cases.title: Atomic allocation
cases.scenario: Compete two matchmakers, cancel and fallback on the same entries; at most one assigned game and one opponent survive.

cases.title: Stockfish assignment
cases.scenario: Human or selected agent faces Stockfish 19 Lite with selected time, random colors and standard starting board.

cases.title: Fallback failure
cases.scenario: Stockfish download/startup failure still permits agent search, then offers Retry or Keep searching if no match.

cases.title: Fixed opponent
cases.scenario: Late candidate, late engine ready and reconnected duplicate tab cannot replace a committed opponent.

cases.title: Queue position isolation
cases.scenario: Friend custom positions never carry into queue entries; colors are random and no color-preference partition exists.

cases.title: Opening clock
cases.scenario: Default opening and 15-second reply abort work for White-to-move and Black-to-move custom FENs; increment is applied exactly once.

cases.title: First-move cancellation
cases.scenario: Cancel before own first accepted move aborts even after opponent's move; after own first move it resigns, including after a takeback.

cases.title: Accepted move ordering
cases.scenario: Duplicate, stale, illegal and wrong-seat intents neither advance state nor mint clock increments.

cases.title: Expiry boundary
cases.scenario: At authoritative expiry a late intent cannot become a move; terminal event order is consistent for both clients.

cases.title: Connected stalling
cases.scenario: With 20 minutes left, a connected opponent may use all time; no abandonment claim appears merely because no move arrives.

cases.title: Optional offline claim
cases.scenario: After 60 continuous seconds offline, prompt Claim win or Keep waiting; waiting preserves play and the optional claim.

cases.title: Reconnect race
cases.scenario: Reconnect accepted first removes claim eligibility; a claim or normal final outcome accepted first remains final.

cases.title: Clock continuity
cases.scenario: Generation, errors, Stop/Retry, navigation, refresh, peer disconnect and control changes do not refund or pause chess time.

cases.title: Control changes
cases.scenario: Human takeover, agent handoff and model switches apply between accepted moves and fence a late old reply.

cases.title: Retry budgets
cases.scenario: Four illegal attempts lose; formatting budget is independent; retry/switch does not reset spent attempts; transport failure alone never resigns.

cases.title: Draw and takeback
cases.scenario: Mutual draw/takeback consent is required; stale takeback cannot rewind later play or restore elapsed time/budgets.

cases.title: Immutable result
cases.scenario: Later replies, claims, rematch/practice or reconnect cannot overwrite a final result.

cases.title: Public identity
cases.scenario: Stable editable username/avatar profile reveals no Clerk email/legal name/auth identifier by default.

cases.title: Guest identity
cases.scenario: Guest has no merged profile; linking a guest seat requires verified ownership and explicit action.

cases.title: Included history
cases.scenario: Completed friend/queue/fallback games appear with correct result/types; aborts are unscored; private/local/practice games stay private.

cases.title: Replay access
cases.scenario: Signed-out visitor reads final public replay with starting board/moves/time/result; live match subscription still requires membership.

cases.title: Control attribution
cases.scenario: Human, model changes and mixed play remain attributed to the correct accepted moves; terminal agent action is labeled. Retain attribution metadata without a separate Declared models per-move list in the interface.

cases.title: Routing privacy
cases.scenario: Custom endpoints, private route IDs, connection nicknames and secret-bearing aliases never leak through public model labels.

cases.title: Assurance
cases.scenario: Declared model/alias or browser Stockfish is not shown as verified actual provider execution.

cases.title: Account deletion
cases.scenario: Delete profile/personal/private owner data and identifying snapshots; anonymized shared games remain as Deleted player.

cases.title: Explicit removal
cases.scenario: Verified erasure removes shared replay from both histories/public URLs; only anonymous opponent aggregate results remain.

cases.title: Private archives
cases.scenario: Opponent/public visitor cannot access another owner's AI conversations/raw traffic; no public projection includes credentials.

cases.title: Rules parity
cases.scenario: Pinned Node/chessops wrapper conformance covers strict FEN, counters, EP, castling, promotions, repetition, mate/draw, material and bounded timeouts.

cases.title: Single writer
cases.scenario: Only Go transaction writer commits versioned canonical state; private rules process cannot write DB or accept public commands.

cases.title: Fresh decision time
cases.scenario: Lock wait crossing a deadline uses a fresh post-lock decision time; old transaction/client timestamps cannot backdate acceptance.

cases.title: Operation receipts
cases.scenario: Lost acknowledgement retried with identical operation returns original result; changed payload with same ID fails.

cases.title: Token and membership
cases.scenario: Reject wrong account/seat/origin, expired/revoked auth and identity-changed stale work; refresh stream authentication within its lifetime.

cases.title: Guest credential
cases.scenario: Consumed invitation cannot control a seat; private scoped guest credentials can reconnect and request their own data removal.

cases.title: Stream recovery
cases.scenario: Finite SSE renewal and poll fallback preserve state/order across cursor gaps, lost events, slow readers and API restarts.

cases.title: Agent runner
cases.scenario: Only current per-seat turn/epoch runner submits; duplicate tabs cannot duplicate accepted move; different explicit games can run concurrently.

cases.title: Uncertain provider work
cases.scenario: Runner loss during an uncertain billable request prompts explicit retry/switch/takeover rather than blindly reissuing.

cases.title: Late timer
cases.scenario: After a delayed deadline worker, resolve original queue cutoffs without double consuming entries or matching post-cutoff candidates.

cases.title: Service outage
cases.scenario: Service failure never becomes peer-abandonment win; recovery adjusts unfinished active deadlines once, fences old epochs and preserves prior terminal results.

cases.title: Backup removal
cases.scenario: Old restore applies latest removal ledger before serving; deleted live data/projections clear within 24h and removed recovery data within 30d.

cases.title: Host verification
cases.scenario: Authorized staging proves Apache streaming/flushing/deadlines, correct CSP/CORS, private worker grants and finite reconnect behavior.

cases.title: Capacity gate
cases.scenario: Measure sustainable clients/games, pool/CPU/storage/connection load without claiming an arbitrary owner cap or unmeasured throughput guarantee.

cases.title: Owner prototype reaction
cases.scenario: Owner reviews concrete friend/queue/game/profile/history and removal states and chooses or corrects the proposed structure.
evidence: 2026-10-20 owner response accepting the proposal with the listed interface corrections; incorporated into the specification/prototype.

cases.title: Native accessible play
cases.scenario: Verify desktop/mobile pointer/touch/keyboard/screen-reader flows in implementation; viewport screenshots alone are insufficient.

cases.title: Concise states
cases.scenario: Retain 20-word product interface and 10-word engine-screen conventions, accessible names and visible keyboard focus; game data is excluded. Clearly represented actions use icons without visible button text, with accessible names, hover labels and visible focus.

cases.title: Concurrent navigation
cases.scenario: Owner can reach parallel games, new explicit entry, current game/reconnect state, public replay and privacy controls without losing shared state.

cases.title: Preserved offline game
cases.scenario: Keep the existing offline layout, setup, local rules/clocks, AI/engine behavior, Undo and keyboard/history tools. Add draw/resign icons without introducing online-match controls or network requirements.

cases.title: Removed attribution panel
cases.scenario: The separate Declared models per-move block is absent from replay/board UI. Relevant model/participant identity remains in agreed game metadata and compact labels.

cases.title: Final agreement
cases.scenario: Owner approves the traced specification after interface review and all consequential follow-up decisions are resolved.
evidence: 2026-10-20 owner response accepting the proposal with the listed interface corrections; incorporated into the specification/prototype.

cases.title: Release separation
cases.scenario: No spec/prototype approval counts as production acceptance, paid usage authorization or public launch approval.

ownerApproval.source: Owner response to the prototype and final handoff question
corrections: Preserve existing offline play and add draw/resign icons
Use icons for clearly represented actions with accessible names and hover labels
Remove the separate Declared models per-move presentation
ownerApproval.scope: Planning agreement, not production acceptance or deployment permission
